<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Counter</title>
<style>
  :root { color-scheme: light dark; }
  body { font: 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0; padding: 1rem; }
  .count { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 600; }
  button { min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 0 1rem; }
  button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main id="root"></main>
<script type="module">
  // Vite builds this to a bundle; the served resource is the bundle. What the
  // shape below reproduces is the served output, not the source tree.
  import { createApp } from './sdk.js';

  const app = createApp();
  let count = 0;

  const root = document.getElementById('root');
  const label = document.createElement('p');
  label.className = 'count';
  const inc = document.createElement('button');
  inc.type = 'button';
  inc.textContent = 'Increment';
  root.append(label, inc);

  function render() {
    label.textContent = String(count);
  }

  inc.addEventListener('click', () => {
    count += 1;
    render();
    app.updateModelContext({ text: 'The counter is now ' + count + '.' });
  });

  app.ready().then(render);
</script>
</body>
</html>
